OLD-GERMAN-HANDWRITING-COMPARISON-01.quote: Use the original scribe’s repeated forms to decide between candidate readings.

OLYMPIC-PARTICIPATION-RECORDS-01.quote: Keep entry in a qualifying trial distinct from selection for the Games.

ORTHODOX-CLERGY-RECORD-RECOVERY-01.quote: Use it before you search metrical books or a present-day oblast archive, and before you merge or split clergy who share a surname.

PENNSYLVANIA-MARRIAGE-LICENSES-AND-RETUR.quote: Search the county that issued the license for each part of the filing.

PERIODICAL-INDEX-SEARCH-RETRIEVAL-01.quote: A personal-name miss therefore usually means the article text was never searched, and a hit is only a citation.

PERIODICAL-INDEX-SEARCH-RETRIEVAL-02.quote: Until the gate is answered, keep the request as an unsent draft on the user's device.

PHILIPPINE-SURNAMES-AND-REGISTERS-01.quote: Match households across the surname change through dated records in the same locality.

POLISH-INDEX-ORIGINAL-RECORD-RECOVERY-01.quote: A register description establishes a lead to holdings, not that the target entry has been inspected. Preserve the complete reference, not just a short number detached from its archive and fonds.

PORTUGUESE-PARISH-CIVIL-REGISTER-RECOVER.quote: Use it before you treat Portuguese records like Spanish or Hispanic ones. That mistake leads to four failures: searching a civil register that did not cover the person, looking in the wrong archive, reading the first surname as the father's, and calling a book missing when another archive holds it.

PROBATE-CASE-DOCUMENT-INVENTORY-01.quote: Keep a case inventory and a queue of unresolved references, so finding one useful document does not silently finish the estate search.

PUBLISHED-BOOK-CATALOGUE-AND-FULL-TEXT-D.quote: A miss is only a miss for that tool, query and range. It never establishes that the book doesn't exist or isn't held.

QUAKER-MEETING-RECORD-RECOVERY-01.quote: Before relying on Hinshaw, check that it covers the meeting. Decode the entry's meeting before you assign it to a place.

RABBINIC-LITERATURE-PERSON-SEARCH-01.quote: Keep two questions apart: did the ancestor exist, and is the bridge from your person to that ancestor documented? Rabbinic books often answer the first and rarely prove the second.

REPOSITORY-PHOTOGRAPH-COLLECTION-SEARCH-.quote: Do not compare faces yourself and do not name anyone from appearance. Resemblance is never evidence on its own: a recognition stays an attributed claim until documents support it.

RESEARCH-DOCUMENTATION-01.quote: Use `NIL` for a completed search with no hits. Record inaccessible images, interrupted searches and unsearched collections with their actual status.

ROOTSMAGIC-TREE-RECONCILIATION-WORKFLOW-.quote: Choose the destination and operation for each object, then inspect the saved result.

RUSSIAN-EMPIRE-EMIGRANT-ORIGIN-RECOVERY-.quote: Preserve the wording and field role until the movement and locality evidence resolve them.

RUSSIAN-EMPIRE-JEWISH-IDENTITY-ATTRIBUTI.quote: **A name mismatch never changes the branch verdict on its own; the household chain does.** Chain the person through household number → previous household number → age at previous revision → "выбыло" column → additional lists before you interpret any name.

RUSSIAN-EMPIRE-JEWISH-METRICAL-BOOK-RECO.quote: Do not search for "the village's" or "the synagogue's" metrical book. Having synagogues, or a sizeable Jewish population, does not show that a place had its own crown rabbi.

RUSSIAN-ESTATE-REGISTRATION-STATUS-01.quote: **A town mark on мещанин or купец names the society of registration, not the birthplace or residence.**

RUSSIAN-HOUSEHOLD-LIST-TRANSCRIPTION-AUD.quote: **Record what the image says, even against other years.**

RUSSIAN-IMPERIAL-SERVICE-RECORD-RECOVERY.quote: Do not stop at metrical books, revision lists or a military archive. A man in state service had his career and family written up in a formulary or service list (формулярный / послужной список).

RUSSIAN-MILITARY-REPRESSION-RECORD-EPISO.quote: an award order after a missing report does not, by itself, establish survival between those dates. Obtain an event-specific source before extending a life or death interval.

RUSSIAN-ORTHODOX-CONFESSION-LIST-READING.quote: The common errors are to read one year as a census, to turn an age into a birth year, to treat a household number as an identifier, and to treat a list entry as proof of a marriage, a parent or a death.

RUSSIAN-ORTHODOX-METRICAL-BOOK-RECOVERY-.quote: Read marriage-count formulae literally, treat margin decrees as separate dated events, and treat names and patronymics as hypotheses rather than proof of descent.

RUSSIAN-REVISION-LIST-HOUSEHOLD-CHAINING.quote: Record each copy as a separate observation of one episode, never as corroboration.

RUSSIAN-VILLAGE-FAMILY-RECONSTITUTION-01.quote: **A surname is a hint, not an identifier.**

RUSSIAN-VOLOST-TOWN-ADMINISTRATION-RECOR.quote: The common mistake is to send the researcher only to church registers and revision lists. That misses the local administrative fonds.

SAMOAN-MATAI-AND-GAFA-RESEARCH-01.quote: Track each title, holder, village and date separately.

SCANDINAVIAN-PARISH-RECORD-RECOVERY-01.quote: Follow the family by farm or residence and by page cross-reference, not by patronymic. Settle identity at the household level.

SCANDINAVIAN-PATRONYMIC-FARM-NAME-RECORD.quote: The name in the parish register is usually not the American surname. Same-named parishioners are common, so separate them by birth date, parents, spouse, farm and vaccination entries, never by name alone.

SCHOOL-UNIVERSITY-RECORD-RECOVERY-01.quote: A compiled or published list is a lead with limited coverage. Absence from it does not show that the person never attended.

SCOTTISH-HIGH-COURT-PRECOGNITIONS-TRIAL-.quote: Take the verdict and sentence from the minute book, never from the precognition.
Do not infer the seriousness of the offence from the court.
Search the minute books before you call the case untraced.
Before you order copies, buy a research package or ask for a closed file, answer the privacy gate in writing.

SCOTTISH-PARISH-STATUTORY-RECORD-RECOVER.quote: Treat register gaps and unsearched denominations as coverage still to search, not as proof the event did not happen.

SOURCE-CITATION-01.quote: An index entry and an inspected original image have different retrieval paths; record which one you used.

SOUTHERN-CLAIMS-COMMISSION-CASE-FILES-01.quote: Find the claimant in the consolidated index before choosing a disposition-specific file series.

SOVIET-PERSONAL-FILE-RECOVERY-01.quote: Keep questionnaires (анкеты) and autobiographies found there as dated self-reports, and keep catalogue hits found by name as candidates.

SPANISH-CIVIL-PARISH-RECORD-ROUTING-01.quote: **Expect the national Registro Civil only from 1 January 1871.**

STATE-ARCHIVES-COUNTY-RECORDS-GUIDES-01.quote: A guide lists what that archives holds. It is not a list of what survives.

STATE-ARCHIVES-COUNTY-RECORDS-GUIDES-02.quote: For an event before that date, search the parent county

STATE-ARCHIVES-COUNTY-RECORDS-GUIDES-03.quote: Check first whether the originals have been digitized since the guide appeared.

STATE-LEGISLATIVE-PRIVATE-ACT-PETITIONS-.quote: search the state's index of legislative acts, gather every entry that shares the hit's locator, and then retrieve the act and the petition or application behind it.

SURNAME-DISTRIBUTION-LOCALITY-LEADS-01.quote: It turns time-sliced maps, attestation dictionaries, a couple's surname overlap and country-wide counts into a **ranked, bounded list of localities to search**. It never produces an origin finding.

SWEDISH-MILITARY-RECORD-ROUTING-01.quote: Swedish military records are not one searchable pool. Each index covers one series, one branch and one period, so classify the man first and read every miss against the coverage of the index you searched.

TAX-ROLL-OBSERVATION-WORKFLOW-01.quote: Check each year against the liability rules in force then, and record every change as a bounded interval.

UK-CENSUS-AND-1939-REGISTER-INTERPRETATI.quote: Before reading any value, settle what that year's image is, who wrote the value, what night or day it refers to and what the year covers.

UNKNOWN-PARENTAGE-WATO-01.quote: WATO assumes single-path descent. Pedigree collapse / endogamy / a match related through two lines silently invalidates the score — the tool has no way to know and will still rank confidently.

WATO-01.quote: **The output is a set of competing hypotheses with *relative* odds — never a verdict.**

WATO-04.quote: When interpreting a reported ranking, ask whether pedigree collapse, endogamy or more than one relationship path could apply to these matches; do not replace the question with a generic warning.

US-20TH-CENTURY-MILITARY-SERVICE-RECONST.quote: Do not claim that the records burned and nothing survives.

US-ARMY-CIVIL-WAR-COURT-MARTIAL-FILES-01.quote: Treat the service-card notation as a locator for a separate proceeding.

US-CENSUS-PRACTICAL-WORKFLOWS-01.quote: Preserve the original census locator and keep literal observations separate from calculations and proposed identities.

US-CHURCH-RECORD-CUSTODY-01.quote: Before searching, work out the exact denominational branch, the record types that branch kept, the congregation or minister who kept the entry, and who holds those registers now. Do not report "not found" or "records lost" until that custody path has been checked.

US-CIVIL-WAR-SERVICE-RECORD-EPISODES-01.quote: It prevents four common errors: treating registration as service, giving the soldier every battle his regiment fought, guessing a transfer's date or meaning, and treating a database miss as proof of non-service.

US-FEDERAL-COURT-CASE-FILE-RECOVERY-01.quote: Decide whether the matter is federal before you search a county courthouse or a large genealogy database.

US-FEDERAL-LAND-ENTRY-FILE-RECOVERY-01.quote: The digitized GLO item is the final grant or warrant image, often a single page. It is not the entry file.

US-FREEDPEOPLE-RECORD-RECOVERY-01.quote: Surname, enslaver, list order and DNA signals stay separate hypotheses until a record names the person.

US-GUARDIANSHIP-RECORDS-01.quote: Do not place a minor ward in the guardian's household unless a record says the child lived there.

US-GUARDIANSHIP-RECORDS-02.quote: Do not read a guardianship as proof that a parent had died, or the word "orphan" as proof that both had.

US-GUARDIANSHIP-RECORDS-03.quote: A failed guardianship search is not evidence that the child did not exist or that the father was alive.

US-MILITARY-PENSION-FILE-RECOVERY-01.quote: Preserve the distinction between an index, a service record, a pension file and an abbreviated copy product.

US-MILITARY-SERVICE-TYPE-RECORD-ROUTING-.quote: The usual failure is to search only federal compiled-service or pension indexes and then report "no service". A related mistake is reading an empty donation-land or bounty-land search as meaningful when the man was never eligible.

US-OBITUARY-SEARCH-AND-INTERPRETATION-01.quote: Read every name, date and relationship in an obituary as the informant's statement, not as a verified fact.

US-OBITUARY-SEARCH-AND-INTERPRETATION-02.quote: A missing spouse, child, sibling, employer or military service is not evidence that none existed.

US-OBITUARY-SEARCH-AND-INTERPRETATION-03.quote: Do not use it to look up a survivor's current address, phone, email, workplace or accounts, and do not trace a minor named in it.

US-PERIOD-LAW-RECORD-READING-01.quote: A rule shows what was required or allowed. It does not show what happened in one family.

US-TRIBAL-ENROLLMENT-RECORD-RECOVERY-01.quote: A rejection alone neither shows nor rules out Native descent.

US-VITAL-REGISTRATION-COVERAGE-01.quote: The usual mistake is to treat the statewide mandate year as the first year of coverage, search one certificate index for one county, and report a negative. Before any absence statement, build a register with one row for each registration authority and each separate series.

USA-IMMIGRATION-SEARCH-RECOVERY-01.quote: The recurring mistake is treating a search miss as a missing ancestor when the failure lies in the selected port, date, recorded name, image, citizenship history or custodian.

VIRGINIA-REVOLUTIONARY-PUBLIC-SERVICE-CL.quote: Treat a hit in the printed abstracts as one series, then pull the same claimant from the certificates and the Commissioner's Books.
Record the supplier, any assignee and the person who presented the claim as separate roles.
When your person is called a commissioner, or signed certificates, do not assume that he held one office from appointment to the end of the war.

WIKITREE-DNA-TESTER-LINKS-01.quote: Do not mark a relationship DNA-confirmed solely because a tester appears in a list or because the external tree link works.

WORLD-WAR-TWO-US-NAVY-BATTLE-RECORDS-01.quote: Establish the person’s assignment and the ship’s or unit’s action separately.

XDNA-PHASING-JUDGMENT-01.quote: **Ban invented small-segment statistics.** Any false-positive-rate or chance-match number must be attributed to a specific company/study (23andMe 2014, AncestryDNA 2020, FTDNA's Family Finder Matching 5.0) — never a smoothed or averaged figure presented as a universal law.

YDNA-MTDNA-INTERPRETATION-01.quote: **you do not compute or assign haplogroups, TMRCAs, or NPE verdicts from your own reasoning.** Every such value is a *hypothesis to route to the right tool or corroborate* — never a fact to state.

Y-01.quote: A GD is *stochastic*, not a clock (below).

Y-02.quote: **you do not compute or assign haplogroups, TMRCAs, or NPE verdicts from your own reasoning.**
